verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a deployment question for hosted or server software. macOS is a locally installed desktop operating system, so asking whether it can be self-hosted is a category error. The evidence pack covers only Continuity, Siri AI, Safari and community reports on bugs and outages, none of which documents a self-hosting capability that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
